instructions: The branch has merge conflicts (see `**branch**` above). The PR is still in the merge queue, but GitHub cannot merge it until the conflicts are resolved. Choose one path: (a) pull it from the queue and resolve now — first run `gh api graphql -f 'query=mutation DequeuePullRequest($id: ID!) { dequeuePullRequest(input: { id: $id }) { mergeQueueEntry { id } } }' -f id=PR_kwDOAAAAAAA` (`gh pr` cannot remove a queue entry); only this PR leaves the queue and the other entries stay queued; then: Update per the repo's instructions, keeping both sides' changes. Once the PR is ready again, enqueue it again (with `--merge`, Shepherd prints the enqueue command). Or (b) wait — skip the dequeue and every step marked `If you chose (a):`, and rerun Shepherd after the polling interval instead of immediately, until GitHub removes the entry itself; this step repeats until then, and an unchanged conflict escalates through `stall-timeout`. On either path, review items stay deferred until the PR leaves the queue.
If you chose (a): Commit any remaining conflict-resolution changes and push to the PR head branch.
If you chose (a), rerun Shepherd now. If you chose (b), rerun Shepherd after the polling interval.
